name: error-growth-p1
description: Growth of the flagship error tree (11-11 ~10:43, coordinator; the user's goal: models that can expand in size). G2's probit error trees (T-P-Ne: NB error router, non-merging per the user's error-family rule, threshold 1M, noise 0.03) reached their limit (9 leaves at limit 4) by cycle 50-75 and held it for 250 cycles while gaining 118 over F-P at ply 1. One factor: split limit 4 x2 against 8 x2 (up to 17 leaves), F-P x2 beside, ply 1, floor 300. Read cold at plies 1-2, T 0.02, with leaf counts over time. A limit-8 gain says the error tree expands productively; a tie or loss says 9 leaves is its useful size on these features (the analyst's reading for cluster trees). Floor raised from 300 to 450 at cycle 28 (11-11 10:46, the analyst's 6.28: a late gain past cycle 400).
